tests.description: Mutation requests reject unregistered issuers, wrong audience, subject/client mismatch, missing sender constraint, replayed jti and Idempotency-Key reuse with a different request digest.
ClientApplication and Platform Tenant are derived server-side from the authenticated workload plus external tenant mapping; body or path identifiers cannot override TenantContext.

A sender-constrained Business revocation is accepted only when path, external tenant, client, bounded issue time and stored CommercialAuthorization ID/digest match. Receipt and fan-out intent are durable and idempotent; matching WorkSessions and new execution/Gateway authorization fail closed immediately, Platform Gateways deny new side effects from old authorization, and every affected active run receives a newly fenced SystemSafetyControl cancellation.
Every JSON mutation enforces its declared encoded-byte limit before parsing and returns 413 without allocating an unbounded body.
